'''Yakine no Mikoto''' (八杵命, also read as Yaki no Mikoto) is a deity from the folk traditions of the [[Suwa Region|Suwa region]] in {{ill|Nagano Prefecture|en|Nagano Prefecture|qid=Q127877|lt=Nagano Prefecture}}, associated with the [[Suwa Faith]] (諏訪信仰). He is revered as a god of development and cultivation.

== Overview ==
Yakine no Mikoto is mentioned in historical sources such as the {{ill|Genealogy of the Deities|ja|神氏系図}}. He is described as a child of {{ill|Takeminakata|en|Takeminakata|qid=Q9150391|qid=Q9150391|lt=Takeminakata}}, but little is recorded beyond his lineage and descendants. The deity is regarded as the ancestral god of the {{ill|Koide clan (Negi Daibu)|ja|小出氏}}, who served as the '''Negi Daibu''' (禰宜大夫), one of the {{ill|Five Priestly Offices|ja|五官祝}} of [[Suwa-taisha|Suwa Taisha]]'s Upper Shrine. However, no detailed genealogical records exist, leaving much of his story shrouded in mystery.

At [[Yagi Shrine]] in [[:en:Shimosuwa, Nagano|Shimosuwa]], Yakine no Mikoto is venerated as a god of development in the historical {{ill|Shinano Province|ckb|پارێزگای شینانۆ|cs|Provincie Šinano|de|Provinz Shinano|eo|Provinco Ŝinano|es|Provincia de Shinano|fa|ولایت شینانو|fr|Province de Shinano|gl|Provincia de Shinano|hak|Shinano-koet|id|Provinsi Shinano|it|Shinano (provincia)|ja|信濃国|knc|Shinano Province|ko|시나노국|lt|Šinano žemė|ms|Wilayah Shinano|nl|Shinano (provincie)|pl|Prowincja Shinano|pt|Província de Shinano|ru|Синано (провинция)|simple|Shinano Province|sk|Šinano (provincia)|sr|Провинција Шинано|th|แคว้นชินาโนะ|tr|Shinano (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Сінано|zh|信濃國|zh_min_nan|Sinano-kok|zh_yue|信濃國|qid=Q289250|lt=Shinano Province}}. Local lore claims that his burial site is located nearby, but the exact location is unknown.

== Interpretations ==
Yakine no Mikoto does not appear in other historical texts, and it is uncertain whether shrines dedicated to him exist outside Nagano Prefecture. Some theories equate him with {{ill|Yahoko no Kami|ja|八桙神}}, the deity enshrined at [[Yahoko Shrine]], an ancient {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|式内社|lt=Shikinaisha}} in [[Awa Province]].

== Lineage ==
Yakine no Mikoto is one of the children of {{ill|Takeminakata|en|Takeminakata|qid=Q9150391|qid=Q9150391|lt=Takeminakata}} and {{ill|Yasakatome|en|Yasakatome|qid=Q9150392|lt=Yasakatome-no-Kami}}. His offspring include:
* [[Kurusu no Kami]]
* [[Hirahuo no Kami]]
* [[Wakaname no Kami]]
* [[Yatate no Kami]] (also known as Hachitama no Kami)
* [[:en:Ōanamuchi|Kuraokami no Kami]] (倉稲主神, also known as Kuraokami)

== Shrines ==
Yakine no Mikoto is venerated at the following locations:
* [[Suwa-taisha|Suwa Taisha]] Upper Shrine - {{ill|Wakamiya Shrine|ja|若御子社}} (Chino City, Nagano Prefecture)
* Suwa Taisha Lower Shrine - {{ill|Wakamiya Shrine|ja|若宮社}} (Shimosuwa, Nagano Prefecture)
* [[Yagi Shrine]] (Shimosuwa, Nagano Prefecture)
